title: Report viewer
responsibility: Presents a report with its recorded evidence and expandable review details.

inputs.name: ReportView.report
inputs.description: Required report providing summary, findings, checks, acceptance criteria, coverage, evidence and replay data.

inputs.name: ReportView.assetBase
inputs.description: Required media address prefix passed to evidence and replay viewers.

inputs.name: ReportView.downloadBase
inputs.description: Required download address prefix passed to the report summary.

inputs.name: ReportView.portable
inputs.description: Optional portable presentation, defaulting to false. True changes the brand destination and hides project-history navigation and upload eligibility.

inputs.name: ReportView.onUploaded
inputs.description: Optional callback forwarded to evidence uploads so the host can receive the updated report.

outputs.name: ReportView
outputs.description: Report summary, findings, evidence gallery, replay and footer. Checks, acceptance and coverage open in a dialog; closing returns focus to the triggering button. Upload eligibility is passed only for an active, nonportable report.
